answer: A decaying identity bond, renewed only by real work, stops mass forgery. To join the meadow of traders, each identity posts a 100 POA bond decaying 5% per epoch, like a trellis for vines still growing: renewal needs completed jobs, not fresh deposits. Keeping 100 fakes alive costs 100 jobs of work each epoch, about 500 POA, while one honest agent pays one renewal. Idle bonds shrink to zero and the identity leaves the inlet for new traders.
